subject: Operations
title: Inventory and Cash Flow
description: A fast breakdown of Inventory and Cash Flow for builders.

hook.text: A profitable company went bankrupt because its cash was locked in unsold inventory. Profit doesn't pay bills—cash does.

buildup.text: Every dollar in inventory is a dollar not available for payroll, rent, marketing, or investment.

discovery.text: The cash conversion cycle measures how long it takes to turn inventory purchases into cash from sales.

twist.text: Amazon's cash conversion cycle is negative—they collect payment before paying suppliers. Inventory funds itself.

climax.text: Lean inventory management frees working capital. Companies that master it grow faster with less external funding.

punchline.text: Inventory is frozen cash. Thaw it wisely.

quiz.question: What does a negative cash conversion cycle mean?
options: It collects payment before paying suppliers
